additional_info.subject: 0448773 - ID0448773-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / RD 170003087] unavailable and disconnected CRM:00472000415
additional_info.body:
Hello Islam,
After today's intervention we fixed the charger. We have factory reset router XF3 and configured it again with companion tools. After fixing the router configuration we had to replace the SIM card since we had no mobile data available.
Last step was to run the restore config with Live linux USB to restore the charger since no outlets were showing on HMI.
Thank you for efforts today, I will now proceed to close this ticket.
